message.content:
**Paris 7‑Day Trip Plan (Mid‑Season, €1,200–€1,800 per person)** | Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | Notes | |-----|---------|-----------|---------|-------| | **Day 1 – Arrival** | • Fly into Charles de Gaulle (CDG) or Orly (ORY).
• Take the RER B (or Orlybus + RER B) to Gare du Nord or Châtelet‑Les Halles.
• Check into a 3‑star hotel or Airbnb in the 1st, 4th, or 7th arrondissement (e.g., Hotel Le Six, Hotel Ekta, or a studio near the Louvre). | • Light walk to the **Louvre** (open 9 am–6 pm).
• Grab a quick lunch at **Café Marly** (inside the Louvre). | • Dinner at **Le Coupe Chou** (classic French, 2‑star Michelin‑level).
• Optional night stroll along the Seine, cross the Pont des Arts. | • Book a **Paris Pass** (includes metro, buses, and entry to many museums). | | **Day 2 – Classic Sights** | • Breakfast at **Café de Flore** (Saint‑Germain‑des‑Près).
• Visit **Notre‑Dame** (exterior) and **Sainte‑Chapelle** (inside). | • Lunch at **Le Petit Cler** (market‑style bistro).
• Walk to **Île de la Cité** → **Île Saint‑Louis** → **Place des Vosges**. | • Dinner at **L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon** (budget‑friendly 2‑star).
• Optional: Seine river cruise (Bateaux Mouches). | • Use the metro (Line 4 to Notre‑Dame, Line 1 to Palais‑Royal). | | **Day 3 – Art & Culture** | • Breakfast at **Du Pain et des Idées** (croissants).
• Visit **Musée d’Orsay** (Renaissance & Impressionism). | • Lunch at **Le Café Marly** (again, or try **Café Campana**).
• Explore **Montmartre**: Sacré‑Coeur, Place du Tertre, and the **Espace Dalí**. | • Dinner at **Le Consulat** (historic Montmartre bistro).
• Optional: Moulin Rouge show (book in advance). | • Metro: Line 12 to Montmartre. | | **Day 4 – Day Trip to Versailles** | • Early breakfast, then take RER C to Versailles Château.
• Tour the **Palace**, Hall of Mirrors, and Gardens (guided tour recommended). | • Picnic lunch in the gardens (pick up baguette, cheese, wine).
• Return to Paris in the late afternoon. | • Dinner at **Le Relais de l’Entrecôte** (steak & frites).
• Evening stroll in the Latin Quarter. | • RER C tickets: €7.10 round‑trip. | | **Day 5 – Modern & Shopping** | • Breakfast at **Café Kitsune** (hipster vibe).
• Visit **Centre Pompidou** (modern art). | • Lunch at **Le Georges** (terrace view).
• Shopping on **Boulevard Haussmann** (Galeries Lafayette, Printemps). | • Dinner at **Septime** (reservations needed).
• Night walk along the **Eiffel Tower** (light show at 20 min intervals). | • Metro: Line 4 to Palais‑Royal, Line 1 to Palais‑Bourbon. | | **Day 6 – Hidden Gems** | • Breakfast at **La Maison du Chocolat**.
• Explore **Le Marais**: Picasso Museum, Musée Carnavalet, and the **Place des Vosges**. | • Lunch at **L’As du Fallafel** (best falafel).
• Visit **Musée Picasso** or **Musée de la Vie Romantique**. | • Dinner at **Le Petit Cler** (again) or **Chez L'Ami Jean** (Basque cuisine).
• Optional: jazz club at **Le Caveau de la Huchette**. | • Metro: Line 1 to Palais‑Bourbon, Line 4 to Saint‑Germain. | | **Day 7 – Departure** | • Pack, check out.
• Quick visit to **Luxembourg Gardens** for a final stroll. | • Lunch at **Le Pain Quotidien** (healthy options). | • Head to CDG/ORY via RER B or Orlybus. | • Keep a buffer of 2 hrs for airport security. | --- ### Transportation & Tickets | Mode | Cost (per person) | Notes | |------|-------------------|-------| | **Paris Pass (7‑day)** | €120 | Includes metro, buses, and free entry to 60+ attractions. | | **RER C to Versailles** | €7.10 | Round‑trip. | | **Metro & Bus** | €1.90 per ride (single ticket) | Or use a **carnet** of 10 tickets (€16.90). | | **Airport Transfer** | €10–€15 (RER B) | Or shared shuttle (~€25). | --- ### Accommodation (3‑star) | Hotel | Price (per night) | Location | |-------|-------------------|----------| | Hotel Le Six | €140 | 1st arrondissement | | Hotel Ekta | €130 | 8th arrondissement | | Airbnb Studio | €90 | 4th arrondissement | *Total accommodation for 7 nights: €630–€980.* --- ### Dining Budget | Meal | Average Cost | |------|--------------| | Breakfast | €5–€10 | | Lunch | €10–€15 | | Dinner | €20–€35 | | Snacks | €5–€10 | *Estimated total for 7 days: €350–€500.* --- ### Suggested Packing List - Comfortable walking shoes (Paris streets are cobblestone). - Light jacket (even in summer evenings can be cool). - Universal power adapter (Type C/E). - Reusable water bottle (many fountains). - Small day bag for museums. --- ### Tips & Hacks 1. **Book major attractions online** (Louvre, Musée d’Orsay, Eiffel Tower) to skip queues. 2. **Use the Metro**: it’s fast, cheap, and covers most tourist spots. 3. **Reserve restaurants** 2–3 weeks ahead, especially for Michelin‑starred places. 4. **Carry a small amount of cash** (€20–€30) for markets, cafés, and tips. 5. **Download offline maps** (Google Maps or Citymapper) for navigation without data. Enjoy your Paris adventure!
